title: RedisKeyspace
description: Canonical Redis key conventions. Single source of truth — no service may invent a key pattern outside this registry. See docs/architecture/24-queue-and-redis-keyspace-contracts.md and docs/architecture/14-event-queue-architecture.md.

namespaces.purpose: Revoked-session fast-lookup denylist so a revoked session cannot be used even with an unexpired access token.
namespaces.ttl: remaining access-token lifetime (<= 15 minutes; <= 5 minutes for admin sessions)
namespaces.failure_behavior: fail open (trust token expiry alone) — degraded revocation window, never a hard auth failure
fail open with a conservative default limit enforced at the edge process level, logged as degraded

namespaces.purpose: Short-TTL response cache for free-text search results.
namespaces.invalidation: natural TTL expiry; explicit purge on exact-match PlaceUpdated where cheap
namespaces.failure_behavior: cache miss, serve from OpenSearch directly

namespaces.purpose: Aggressively cached autocomplete suggestions for repeat-prefix typing bursts.
namespaces.failure_behavior: cache miss, serve from OpenSearch directly

namespaces.purpose: Short-TTL cache for nearby/bounded place list queries.
namespaces.failure_behavior: cache miss, serve from PostGIS/OpenSearch directly

namespaces.purpose: Deduplicates/caches identical route computation requests, bucketed by a coarse traffic-freshness time window.
namespaces.ttl: 60 seconds (default; configurable, bucketed to traffic freshness window)
namespaces.failure_behavior: every request recomputed against the routing engine (higher load, not broken)

namespaces.purpose: Live NavigationState hash: current leg/step, map-matched location, off_route, eta, server_sequence.
namespaces.serializer: hash fields, primitives raw / nested objects as JSON strings
namespaces.ttl: session lifetime + grace period (renewed on each update)
namespaces.invalidation: explicit delete on session termination; TTL as backstop
namespaces.failure_behavior: degrade to REST-poll-and-recompute from the navigation schema (durable state); live push unavailable until recovery

namespaces.purpose: Short, operation-bound distributed mutual exclusion (e.g., serializing a specific MapDataVersion publish).
namespaces.invalidation: explicit release + TTL backstop against holder crash
namespaces.failure_behavior: publish jobs queue/wait rather than risk a race
idempotency protection temporarily unavailable; worst case is a duplicate side effect during the outage window, mitigated by unique-constraint safeguards in PostgreSQL where applicable

namespaces.purpose: BullMQ-managed queue/job-state keys for every job_type in ../queues/registry.md.
namespaces.ttl: per BullMQ job retention config (completed/failed job retention, separate from business TTL)
namespaces.failure_behavior: jobs remain queued (Redis persistence/AOF); a worker-fleet outage delays async work without losing it
